title: Aṭvār-i Salāsa ('The Three Stages/Types [of Sufis]')
transliterated_title: Aṭvār-i Salāsa (var. R. dar Taṣavvuf; R. fī l-Marātib al-Thalātha min al-Taṣawwuf)

date.basis: MK: 'completed before' the date of the Majlis 10196 copy (ff. 145b-48a); a copying date and only a terminus ad quem for composition; not asterisked. A second early copy, MS Majlis 1918/21, is dated 828/1425.

manuscript: 20 copies listed; earliest dated: MS Majlis 10196 ff. 145b-48a (7 Shawwāl 828/22 Aug 1425) and MS Majlis 1918/21 pp. 185-201 (828/1425); then MS 5423 (842/1439), MS 1825 (851/1447), BL Add. 23983 (858/1454), Cairo MS 5 (864/1460), and later copies.
summary: A treatise on three types of Sufi (muḥaqqiqān, abrār, akhyār) in an introduction and three aṣls; the number of early MSS suggests its popularity in the 9th/15th century.
